tests.title: Enroll a QA learner in an available course session
tests.goal: A QA learner can enroll in an available course session and receives a confirmed enrollment.
preconditions: An active staging course timetable has an available session and notification routing is confirmed safe.
data: Course and available session selected dynamically.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and open course enrolment.
Select a course session with available seats.
Enter QA-only learner details and submit the enrolment.
Open the enrollment record and timetable.

expected.text: The enrollment is linked to the selected learner, course, and session.
The enrollment status is confirmed and session availability reflects the new enrollment.
No message reaches a real person.

checks.label: The enrollment is linked to the selected learner, course, and session.
The enrollment status is confirmed and session availability reflects the new enrollment.
No message reaches a real person.
